name: Quattrolitaire
author: Gavin Nugent
description: Klondike solitaire for omarchy-shell. Drag-and-drop card table drawn entirely in QML, coloured from the active theme, with undo, autocomplete, scoring and a game that survives a shell restart. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.quattrolitaire

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Quattrolitaire table
